rules: Templates are immutable once hashed: any change to body/subject/channel/flags is a NEW version with a new content_hash.
approval.status is 'draft' until Michael pre-approves a version (an Approval row with scope=standing_rule needs step-up, MICHAEL_DECISIONS #5). Until then every send needs a per-message YES.
A binding template (offer, quote, deposit, hold) is always tier 0 + irreversible + step-up, even after pre-approval.
DISCLOSURE is inserted verbatim into every first message of a thread and every voice opening (E1).
content_hash = MBOS-CJSON-1 sha256 of {template_id, version, channel, subject, body, binding, commercial} (ADR-0010).
disclosure: This is an automated assistant writing on behalf of Michael.
voice_disclosure: Hi, this is an automated AI assistant calling on behalf of Michael. This call may be recorded.

templates.purpose: first contact about a specific listing
templates.subject: Your {{listing_title}}
templates.body: Hi, {{disclosure}} Is your {{listing_title}} still available? {{question_1}} {{question_2}} Thanks.

templates.purpose: first contact about a specific listing

templates.purpose: follow-up questions in an active thread
templates.subject: Re: {{listing_title}}

templates.body: Could you text a photo of {{photo_subject}}? It helps me make you a fair offer.

templates.subject: Offer on your {{listing_title}}
templates.body: Michael can offer ${{offer_amount}} cash for the {{listing_title}}, picked up {{pickup_window}}, subject to it matching the description. This offer is open until {{offer_expires}}.

templates.subject: Your {{service_name}} request
templates.body: Thanks for reaching out about {{service_name}}. {{disclosure}} {{question_1}} {{question_2}} Michael will follow up with a quote.

templates.body: Could you send two photos of {{photo_subject}}, one up close and one from across the room? Then Michael can give you a firm quote.

templates.body: Michael's quote for {{scope_summary}} is ${{quote_amount}}, including materials. A {{deposit_pct}}% deposit holds a date. Quote valid until {{quote_expires}}.
